name: Evermere Primer
description: Places and customs used in the Evermere story.

entries.title: The Moonwell

canon.content: The Moonwell lies beneath the ruined abbey. Its water reflects possible futures but never guarantees them.

current.content: The Moonwell lies beneath the ruined abbey. Since the autumn eclipse, its water has shown only the northern road.

entries.notes: Private author note: reveal the cause of the eclipse later.

entries.title: Evermere Guest Right

canon.content: A host who offers bread and salt owes a guest safety until the next sunrise.

current.content: A host who offers bread and salt owes a guest safety until the next sunrise. Breaking guest right causes lasting public disgrace.
